# CatholicDoorway

> A free, ad-free guide to the Catholic faith: prayers, the Bible, daily readings, finding a church, OCIA, saints and more. Written for Catholics and for anyone exploring the faith or starting OCIA (the Order of Christian Initiation of Adults). Free, no ads, no sign-up. English, Spanish, Portuguese and Filipino (Tagalog).

Content follows the teaching of the Catholic Church and cites the Catechism of the Catholic Church and Scripture. U.S. focused for parishes, dioceses and holy days. Saint and diocese data come from Wikidata (CC0) and are refreshed weekly; the church map uses OpenStreetMap data. Corrections: hello@catholicdoorway.com.

## Becoming Catholic and practical guides

- [Begin Here: Becoming Catholic (OCIA)](https://catholicdoorway.com/start-here): New to the Catholic Church? How OCIA works, the four stages, how long it takes, who to contact, and what to expect at your first Mass.
- [Your First Mass: A Step-by-Step Guide](https://catholicdoorway.com/first-mass): Going to Mass for the first time? A step-by-step companion for your phone: when to stand, sit and kneel, what people say, and what to do at Communion.
- [Catholic How-To Guides: Confession, Baptism, Marriage and More](https://catholicdoorway.com/how-to): Plain, practical Catholic how-tos: going to Confession, joining a parish, baptizing a child, getting married, Last Rites, funerals and coming back to the Church.
- [How to Go to Confession: A Step-by-Step Guide](https://catholicdoorway.com/confession): How to go to Catholic Confession: when and where, how to prepare, exactly what to say, and what to do if it has been years.
- [Examination of Conscience for Kids, Teens and Adults](https://catholicdoorway.com/examination-of-conscience): A Catholic examination of conscience before Confession, in versions for kids, teens and adults. Tick what applies and make a private list on your phone.
- [Coming Back to the Catholic Church](https://catholicdoorway.com/coming-back): Been away from the Catholic Church? How to come back: Mass, talking with a priest, Confession, and special situations like marriage outside the Church.
- [How to Join (Register at) a Catholic Parish](https://catholicdoorway.com/join-a-parish): Why and how to register at a Catholic parish in the U.S., and what it helps with: sponsor letters, baptisms, weddings and Catholic school.
- [How to Have Your Child Baptized Catholic](https://catholicdoorway.com/baptism): How infant baptism works in a Catholic parish: when to call, the preparation class, godparent requirements, the ceremony and special situations.
- [How to Be Confirmed in the Catholic Church: Teens and Adults](https://catholicdoorway.com/confirmation): Catholic Confirmation explained: what it is, the age in U.S. dioceses, adult Confirmation, choosing a sponsor and a Confirmation name, and what happens at the Mass.
- [First Holy Communion: Preparation, the Day and How to Receive](https://catholicdoorway.com/first-communion): How First Communion works in a U.S. parish: age and preparation, First Confession, what to wear, fasting, how to receive Communion, and options for older children and adults.
- [How to Get Married in the Catholic Church](https://catholicdoorway.com/marriage): Getting married in the Catholic Church: how far ahead to start, marriage preparation, documents, marrying a non-Catholic, previous marriages and convalidation.
- [Holy Orders and Vocations: Becoming a Priest, Deacon or Religious](https://catholicdoorway.com/holy-orders): What Holy Orders is, the difference between deacons, priests and bishops, how to discern a vocation, seminary and diaconate formation, and religious life for women and men.
- [Anointing of the Sick and Last Rites: When to Call a Priest](https://catholicdoorway.com/anointing): When and how to call a priest for Anointing of the Sick or Last Rites, what the sacraments are, and what to do if someone is dying now.
- [Planning a Catholic Funeral](https://catholicdoorway.com/funerals): How to plan a Catholic funeral: the vigil, funeral Mass and committal, cremation rules, costs, and having a Mass offered for the deceased.
- [How to Get a Copy of Your Catholic Baptism Certificate](https://catholicdoorway.com/baptism-certificate): How to request your Catholic baptism record with notations for a wedding or sponsor letter, including closed parishes and baptisms abroad.
- [List Your Parish's OCIA Program](https://catholicdoorway.com/ocia-listing): Parish OCIA coordinators: add your contact so people exploring the Catholic faith near you know who to call. Free, reviewed before publishing.

## Prayer, Scripture and the calendar

- [Catholic Prayers and How to Pray the Rosary](https://catholicdoorway.com/prayers): Traditional Catholic prayers, from the Our Father and Hail Mary to the Memorare, plus a step-by-step guide to the Rosary.
- [Pray the Rosary Online, Bead by Bead](https://catholicdoorway.com/rosary): An interactive Rosary: tap through each bead with the prayers, today's mysteries and their Scripture passages. Free, no app needed.
- [Watch Mass Online: Daily Livestreams and Help for the Homebound](https://catholicdoorway.com/watch-mass): Watch Catholic Mass online: EWTN, CatholicTV, the National Shrine, Vatican News and Spanish, Portuguese and Filipino streams in your time zone, parish livestreams, and Communion at home.
- [Catholic Devotions and Prayer Reminders](https://catholicdoorway.com/devotions): The best-loved Catholic devotions with the words to pray: the Rosary, Divine Mercy Chaplet, Stations of the Cross, novenas and the Angelus, with free calendar reminders.
- [How to Pray the Divine Mercy Chaplet, Step by Step](https://catholicdoorway.com/divine-mercy-chaplet): Pray the Divine Mercy Chaplet bead by bead on your phone: the prayers for each decade, the 3 p.m. Hour of Mercy and the Divine Mercy Novena.
- [Stations of the Cross: Pray All 14 Stations](https://catholicdoorway.com/stations-of-the-cross): Pray the Stations of the Cross with a picture, Scripture, a reflection and the traditional prayers for each of the 14 stations, one station at a time on your phone.
- [Catholic Novenas and This Year's Dates](https://catholicdoorway.com/novenas): How to pray a novena, with prayers and this year's dates for novenas to St. Joseph, the Holy Spirit, Divine Mercy, the Sacred Heart, Our Lady of Guadalupe and more.
- [The Angelus and Regina Caeli Prayers](https://catholicdoorway.com/angelus): The words of the Angelus, prayed at 6 a.m., noon and 6 p.m., and the Regina Caeli for the Easter season, with a free daily reminder.
- [Liturgy of the Hours: Today's Morning and Evening Prayer](https://catholicdoorway.com/liturgy-of-the-hours): Pray today's Morning, Evening and Night Prayer of the Liturgy of the Hours, and learn how the Divine Office works and how to begin.
- [Advent and Christmas: Dates, Wreath Prayers and Traditions](https://catholicdoorway.com/advent): This year's Advent and Christmas dates, Advent wreath prayers for each week, the O Antiphons, Simbang Gabi and Las Posadas, Confession before Christmas and the Christmas Masses.
- [The Bible and Today's Mass Readings](https://catholicdoorway.com/bible): Today's Catholic Mass readings, how the Catholic Bible is arranged, and where to read it free online.
- [Read the Catholic Bible Online: Douay-Rheims, All 73 Books](https://catholicdoorway.com/read-the-bible): Read the complete Catholic Bible free online in the Douay-Rheims translation: all 73 books, chapter by chapter, with quick passage lookup such as John 3:16.
- [Bible in a Year and Catechism in a Year: Free Catholic Reading Plans](https://catholicdoorway.com/reading-plans): Free Catholic reading plans: the Bible in a Year, the Catechism in a Year, the Gospels in 30 days and a 90-day OCIA plan. Start any day, track progress, no sign-up.
- [Catholic Holy Days of Obligation and Fasting Calendar](https://catholicdoorway.com/calendar): Holy days of obligation, fasting days and major Catholic feasts for the U.S., with a free calendar you can add to your iPhone, Google or Outlook.

## Kids and families

- [Catholic Kids and Families: Coloring Pages, Prayers and Saint Stories](https://catholicdoorway.com/kids): Free Catholic activities for kids and families: printable coloring pages, first prayers read aloud, the Mass for kids, saint stories and ideas for each season at home.
- [Free Catholic Coloring Pages: Saints, Bible Stories and the Mass](https://catholicdoorway.com/coloring-pages): Seventeen free, original Catholic coloring pages: saints, Bible stories, the Mass and the seasons. Print them or tap to color on a phone or tablet.
- [First Prayers for Catholic Kids, Read Aloud](https://catholicdoorway.com/first-prayers): The Sign of the Cross, Our Father, Hail Mary, Glory Be, Guardian Angel prayer, grace and bedtime prayers for children, in large type with read-aloud.
- [The Mass for Kids: A Picture Guide](https://catholicdoorway.com/mass-for-kids): A picture guide to the Catholic Mass for children: what happens, when to stand, sit and kneel, what we say, and an I-spy game for church.
- [Saint Stories for Kids](https://catholicdoorway.com/saint-stories): Short, true stories of saints for children, from St. Francis and St. Thérèse to St. Carlo Acutis and St. Lorenzo Ruiz, with something to try for each.
- [Catholic Family Corner: Advent, Lent and Easter at Home](https://catholicdoorway.com/family-corner): Simple ways for Catholic families to live Advent, Christmas, Lent and Easter at home, plus printable First Communion and Confirmation prep sheets.

## What Catholics believe

- [What Catholics Believe](https://catholicdoorway.com/beliefs): A plain-language overview of Catholic belief and practice: the Creed, the seven sacraments, Scripture and Tradition, Mary and the saints, and the moral life.
- [Honest Questions About the Catholic Church, Answered](https://catholicdoorway.com/questions): Short, kind, straight answers to the questions people ask about Catholics: Mary, saints, confession, the Pope, purgatory, the extra Bible books and more.
- [Catechism of the Catholic Church and Major Church Documents](https://catholicdoorway.com/church-documents): Look up any paragraph of the Catechism, browse it by topic, and search the major encyclicals, apostolic letters and Vatican II documents, with links to the official texts.
- [Catholic Terms: Words Explained Simply](https://catholicdoorway.com/glossary): Plain-English definitions of Catholic words, from Absolution to Zucchetto, browsable by theme with related terms linked.
- [Anatomy of a Catholic Church: Nave, Sanctuary, Altar, Tabernacle](https://catholicdoorway.com/church-anatomy): An illustrated floor plan of a Catholic church: tap the narthex, nave, sanctuary, altar, ambo, tabernacle, votive candles and more to learn what each one is.
- [Inside the Mass: Why Catholics Stand, Sit, Kneel and Respond](https://catholicdoorway.com/inside-the-mass): Why Catholics stand, sit and kneel at Mass, what the gestures mean, and where the people's responses come from, part by part.
- [What Priests and Deacons Wear: Vestments and Liturgical Colors](https://catholicdoorway.com/vestments): Illustrated guide to Catholic vestments (alb, stole, chasuble, dalmatic, cassock) and why the liturgical colors change through the Church year.

## Saints, Popes and Church structure

- [Catholic Saints, Blesseds and Venerables](https://catholicdoorway.com/saints): Meet the saints, and learn the path to sainthood: Servant of God, Venerable, Blessed and Saint.
- [Saints and Causes Directory: Saints, Blesseds, Venerables, Servants of God](https://catholicdoorway.com/saints-directory): Search thousands of Catholic Saints, Blesseds, Venerables and Servants of God by name, country, century and patronage. Updated weekly.
- [Succession of Popes, from St. Peter to Leo XIV](https://catholicdoorway.com/popes): Every Pope in order from St. Peter to Leo XIV: number in the line of succession, years as Pope, birth and death, and what each is remembered for.
- [How the Catholic Church Is Organized](https://catholicdoorway.com/structure): How the Catholic Church is organized: the Pope, bishops, dioceses, parishes, priests and deacons, explained simply.
- [U.S. Catholic Dioceses Directory](https://catholicdoorway.com/dioceses): Every Catholic diocese, archdiocese and eparchy in the United States: its bishop, cathedral, website, OCIA help and local saints.
- [Find a Catholic Church Near You](https://catholicdoorway.com/find-a-church): Find Catholic churches near you on a free map built from OpenStreetMap, with address, phone, website and directions.

## About

- [About CatholicDoorway](https://catholicdoorway.com/about): About CatholicDoorway.com: a free, ad-free guide to the Catholic faith. Sources, data and corrections.
- [Privacy Policy](https://catholicdoorway.com/privacy): How CatholicDoorway.com handles information: no ads, no trackers, no accounts. What the OCIA listing form, email and church map use, and your choices.
- [Terms of Use](https://catholicdoorway.com/terms): Terms of use for CatholicDoorway.com: an independent guide, not an official Church resource. Mass times, parish OCIA listings and how you may share our content.

## Other languages

- [Español](https://catholicdoorway.com/es/): Una guía gratuita y sin anuncios de la fe católica: oraciones, la Biblia, lecturas del día, cómo encontrar una iglesia, OCIA, santos y más.
- [Português](https://catholicdoorway.com/pt/): Um guia gratuito e sem anúncios da fé católica: orações, a Bíblia, leituras do dia, como encontrar uma igreja, OCIA, santos e mais.
- [Filipino (Tagalog)](https://catholicdoorway.com/tl/): Isang libre at walang patalastas na gabay sa pananampalatayang Katoliko: mga dasal, ang Bibliya, mga pagbasa sa araw-araw, paghahanap ng simbahan, OCIA, mga santo at iba pa.

## Data

- [Diocese pages](https://catholicdoorway.com/dioceses): one page for each of 204 U.S. dioceses, archdioceses and eparchies at /dioceses/<slug>.
- [Saints directory data](https://catholicdoorway.com/data/saints-directory.json): JSON list of Saints, Blesseds, Venerables and Servants of God.
- [Holy days calendar](https://catholicdoorway.com/api/calendar.json): JSON feed of U.S. holy days of obligation, fast days and major feasts (also .ics).
- [Prayer reminders](https://catholicdoorway.com/api/devotions.ics): iCalendar feed of Angelus, 3 p.m. Divine Mercy, Lenten Stations and novena reminders.
- [Saint of the day](https://catholicdoorway.com/data/saint-days.json): the fixed-date celebrations of the U.S. General Roman Calendar (MM-DD keys).
- [Sitemap](https://catholicdoorway.com/sitemap.xml)
